lore_anchors.definition: A class of small, fast magical tools, often used for stealth and assassination. Their "yin" nature marks them as pragmatic, not honorable, weapons in the cultivation world.
A portion of a true magical treasure's power sealed into a talisman. They are limited-use, powerful, and often irreplaceable strategic assets.
A legendary elixir that can help a peak Foundation Establishment cultivator break through to the Core Formation stage. A single pill is a treasure worth immense risk.
A cultivator's spiritual perception, capable of scanning an area for life, qi, and enemies. A powerful divine sense is the mark of a high-level cultivator.
The third major cultivation realm, signifying a qualitative leap in power and lifespan. Forming a Golden Core is the ultimate goal of many cultivators in the lower realms.
A dimensional pocket used by cultivators to carry items, its size and value scale with the cultivator's power and wealth.
